summary: Full audit of the four public entry points: Formular, Dokument hochladen, Konto eröffnen and Anmelden. Backend: 26 pytest tests (25 pass, 1 fail) plus manual curl checks. Frontend: Playwright E2E on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). The happy paths work end to end. FORMULAR: invalid code shows the German error 'Ungültiger Zugangscode'; a valid code leads to /banks (6 banks, 12 products); all 12 /vertrag routes load without a crash (plus the produktinfo and bedingungen pages); protected routes redirect to /formular without a session; revoking a code invalidates its sessions. Four contract forms were filled and submitted fully through the UI (ING Flexgeld, BBVA Flexgeld, bunq-NL Festgeld, Postbank Festgeld) and three more via API (ING, BBVA, bunq-NL Flexgeld). All returned 200, showed the success screen and appear in Admin 'Vertrags-Einreichungen'. DOKUMENT HOCHLADEN works on mobile: wrong code shows a German error, .exe is rejected on the client, a PDF upload succeeds, and the code is single-use (second verify returns 401 'bereits verwendet'). Admin sees the submission, can download the file (real %PDF bytes) and can mark it handled. KONTO ERÖFFNEN works: duplicate email gives the German error 'Diese E-Mail-Adresse ist bereits registriert.'; registration shows a success screen; login leads to /onboarding; the 4 steps ('Schritt bestätigen') end on /dashboard/uebersicht with onboarding_completed=true; forgot-password works and gives a neutral German message. However there are 2 crash bugs, 1 data-loss bug, several security gaps and UX issues (see action_items).

critical.issue: The signed contract PDF (pdfBase64) is never saved to storage. It is only attached to the emails, and the record only stores {filename, kind}. Admin detail dialog shows 'Keine PDFs in Storage verfügbar.' If the email fails, the customer's signed contract is lost permanently. Reproduced: all 4 UI submissions got admin_email_error '502 (429 rate_limited)' and no PDF exists anywhere. The customer still saw the success screen.

No formular session or access code is required. Anyone on the internet can POST and trigger a branded email with an arbitrary PDF attachment to ANY address (open mail relay / phishing vector). Rate limit is 5/min per bucket per IP across 12 buckets, so about 60 mails/min. The endpoint should require a valid formular session_id (frontend has it in sessionStorage 'formular_session_id').

formSummaryHtml from the client is inserted raw into the admin email, and customer_name is interpolated unescaped into the admin and customer HTML. Verified: payload 'inj' was accepted and sent. This allows HTML injection into the staff mailbox. Escape the values or build the summary on the server.

critical.endpoint: Rate limits / IP detection (formular_access.py:87-110, contract_submissions.py:97-98, auth.py:100, storage_files.py:52)
critical.issue: The client IP is taken from the last X-Forwarded-For entry. In this ingress setup that is the internal 10.49.x.x proxy IP (seen in formular_access_fail_log.ip). So all visitors share one counter: 10 wrong codes by anyone in 15 minutes lock /formular and /dokument-upload for every customer (429), and 5 registrations/min is global. Use the first XFF hop or a trusted-proxy setup.

minor.issue: Backend only enforces min_length=8. The frontend policy (10 chars, upper/lower/digit/special, blacklist) can be bypassed with a direct API call.
Multi-use FORMULAR codes are also accepted for document upload (verified 200) and are never consumed. This defeats the 'Einmal-Code' promise. Decide whether that is intended.
MIME check relies on the client-supplied Content-Type only; there is no magic-byte sniffing.
Single-use race: the code status is set to 'used' only after the storage upload, so two parallel submits with the same code both succeed. Use an atomic find_one_and_update at the start.
The docstring says the admin can re-send failed mails from the UI, but no resend endpoint exists. Mails that fail with a provider 429 are lost with no retry or queue.
The public response leaks adminNotifyEmail, adminEmailError and customerEmailError (internal details).
Raw exception text is returned to the client ('Persistenz fehlgeschlagen: {exc}', 'Storage-Upload fehlgeschlagen: {e}').
customer_email_sent and customer_email_error are not returned, so the admin cannot see whether the customer got a confirmation. There is also no DELETE endpoint (cleanup had to be done via Mongo).
No TTL index; the collection grows forever.
Onboarding stores country as the label 'Deutschland', while other users have the ISO code 'DE'. Inconsistent data.

ui_bugs.issue: CRASH: if the code is shorter than 4 characters (or the name is 1 character), the backend returns 422 with a Pydantic detail ARRAY. toast.error(detail) renders the array, the whole app crashes ('Objects are not valid as a React child') and shows a blank error page. Reproduced on desktop.

Same crash with code 'AB' (422 array detail passed to toast.error). Reproduced on mobile. Fix both pages with a helper that maps an array detail to a German message; also add a client-side check for 4 to 32 characters.

After submit the page is not scrolled to the top. The user stays at scrollY 1700 to 5300, looking at the footer, and the 'Antrag erfolgreich eingereicht' card is off-screen. Add window.scrollTo(0,0) when submitted.
The success screen and toast are shown even when both the admin and customer emails failed (adminEmailSent=false). The customer believes the request was received, but with no stored PDF it is lost.
No IBAN checksum or format validation: 'DE00INVALID' was accepted and submitted. BIC is not validated either.

Country and phone entered at /register are thrown away (only email, password and name are sent). Onboarding then asks for phone and country again (empty fields). Send them or PATCH /users/onboarding after register.

Misleading copy: 'Prüfung durch unser Team 1–2 Werktage … Eine E-Mail erreicht Sie …, sobald Ihr Konto freigeschaltet ist'. In reality there is no approval gate (login works immediately) and no email is sent.

Text says 'Es wird nur eine Admin-Benachrichtigung … gesendet', which is wrong because the backend also sends a customer confirmation. Opening a detail auto-marks the row 'handled' (line 161-163). Download code passes storagePath to /document-uploads/files/{file_id}/download (line 140), so it would not work even if a path existed.

integration_issues.issue: Forms call fetch('/api/send-…') with a relative URL instead of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / getApiBase() (e.g. IngContractForm.js:223). They also send no formular session_id, so the backend cannot gate the request.

issues: The top label 'FRÖHLICH VERMÖGENSBERATUNG · SICHERER ZUGANG' (PasswordPage.js:81-83, absolute) overlaps the logo image block.
The floating chat bubble covers the left part of the WEITER / 'Dokumente senden' buttons.
The career popup 'Finanzberater gesucht' appears on top of the protected contract flow (/banks). It should be suppressed on /formular, /banks/* and /dokument-upload.

customer_emails_per_flow.formular_contract: Admin mail (to kundenservice@essenceinvest.com, PDF + signature PNGs) and customer confirmation 'Ihre Antragsbestätigung' with PDF. Verified delivered with delivered@resend.dev. @example.com addresses are blocked by the provider (422 undeliverable), and a burst of about 6 mails gave 429 rate_limited for the admin mail.
customer_emails_per_flow.dokument_upload: ONLY the admin mail 'Neuer Dokument-Upload: {name}'. No customer confirmation (no customer email field exists).
customer_emails_per_flow.register: NO welcome or verification email at all.
customer_emails_per_flow.forgot_password: Reset email (neutral German response verified; delivery not checked).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the 422 array-detail crash in PasswordPage.js:45-46 and DokumentHochladen.js:126-127 (normalize detail to a string; add a client-side length check).

CRITICAL: Persist the contract PDF (and signatures) in storage in contract_submissions.py before sending mail; expose contract_pdf_path/file_id in the admin list and fix the AdminContractSubmissions download URL.
HIGH: Require a valid formular session_id on all /api/send-*-contract-email endpoints (frontend sends it from sessionStorage).
HIGH: HTML-escape customer_name and build formSummaryHtml on the server (no raw client HTML in emails).
HIGH: Fix the client-IP extraction in the rate limiters (first XFF hop) so one bad actor cannot lock out all customers.
HIGH: scrollTo(0,0) on the contract success screen; show a warning or retry if the admin mail failed; add a retry/resend mechanism for failed mails.
MEDIUM: Add IBAN checksum and BIC validation in all contract forms.
MEDIUM: Send country and phone from /register (or patch onboarding) and fix the misleading 'Freischaltung/E-Mail' success copy, or add a real welcome email.
MEDIUM: Decide whether formular codes may be used for document upload; make the doc-code consumption atomic.

LOW: Enforce the backend password policy (match the frontend); add customer_email_sent to the admin list and a DELETE endpoint; remove leaked internals from the public responses; add a TTL index on formular_access_fail_log; add data-testids to DokumentHochladen, OnboardingWizard, AdminContractSubmissions and the contract form personal fields; fix the mobile header overlap on /formular; suppress the career popup in the formular flow.
critical_code_review_comments: IngContractForm.js, BunqContractForm.js, PostbankContractForm.js (1145 lines each) and BBVAContractForm.js (1177) are near-identical. This is a massive DRY violation; extract a shared ContractForm with a bank config.
DokumentHochladen.js:19-22 declares const API before imports (works through hoisting, but lint-unsafe).
Navigation.js mobile 'Formular' link (line ~470) has no data-testid; nav-register-btn and nav-login-btn testids are duplicated between desktop and mobile.

success_rate.backend: 96% (25/26 pytest; the failure is the real bug 'PDF not persisted')
success_rate.frontend: ~80% (all happy paths pass; 2 crash bugs, success-scroll bug, data-loss on mail failure)

seed_data_creation: Everything was cleaned up: formular codes (TEST_audit71_*) revoked and deleted, doc-upload codes and submissions deleted via the admin API, 2 registered users (audit+reg*@example.com) deleted via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}, and 11 contract_form_submissions with customer_name ^TEST deleted via Mongo (no admin DELETE endpoint exists). One test mail went to delivered@resend.dev (Resend sink).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-n 0' (pytest.ini forces xdist and the module-level STATE breaks under it). Skip the visitor gate by setting localStorage kapitalmitte_visitor_profile + kapitalmitte_cookie_consent in add_init_script; dismiss the career popup by clicking 'Später' (do NOT remove the dialog node via JS, because that causes a React removeChild crash). Contract form filler helper: /tmp/fill_form.py (DatePicker ids birth-date/id-issued/id-valid, Steuer-ID 86095742719, radio #quarterly or #fest-quarterly, Radix checkboxes, canvas signature). The onboarding button is 'Schritt bestätigen'. @example.com recipients are blocked by the email provider (422); use delivered@resend.dev to verify customer mails. Watch the provider 429 under bursts.
rca of the issue: 1) Crash: FastAPI/Pydantic 422 returns detail as a list of objects; both access pages pass it straight to sonner toast.error, which renders it as a React child and throws. Repro: /formular, name 'Audit Tester', code 'AB', Weiter. 2) Lost contracts: _handle_contract_submission only puts the PDF into email attachments; when Resend returns 429 or 422 nothing survives. Repro: submit 4 forms quickly, then the admin row shows 'Fehler', 'Keine PDFs in Storage verfügbar'. 3) Global lockout: _client_ip takes xff.split(',')[-1], which is the ingress pod IP (10.49.x.x).
